senses.gloss:
भिद् 1. भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. भिनत्ति,
भिन्त्ते (Ved. also cl. 1. भेदति), Impf.
अभिनत् (2nd sing. अभिनस् or अभिनत्, 1st sing.
Ved. अभेदम्, 2nd sing. अभेत्, भेत्), Impv. भि-
नत्तु (2nd sing. भिन्द्धि or भिन्धि), बिभेद
(2nd sing. बिभेदिथ), बिभिदे (Part. बिभिद्वस्),
भेत्स्यति, -ते, Aor. अभिदत् and अभैत्सीत्, अभित्त
[]
(2nd sing. अभित्थास्), Inf. भेत्तुम् (Ved. भेत्-
तवै), to break, split, cleave, slit, cut asunder, sever,
rend, tear, pierce, penetrate; to break through or
down, burst through (e. g. सेतुम् भिद्, to break
through an embankment; तिमिरम् भिद्, to break
through or disperse darkness); to violate (e. g. सन्-
धिम् भिद्, to violate a compact or alliance); to
interrupt, disturb; to tear up; to destroy; to divide,
separate; to open; to make to open or blossom,
expand; to divide into parts or portions, disjoin,
disunite; to loose, loosen, dissolve; to unravel, extri-
cate; to betray, disclose; to set at variance; to
unsettle, perplex; to alter, change, make to differ;
to distinguish, discriminate: Pass. भिद्यते, to be
split; to burst (e. g. शीतेन, with frost); to be torn
asunder; to be destroyed; to be harassed or afflicted;
to be divided or separated; to open, be opened,
become relaxed; to expand, blossom, bloom; to
become loose, be loosened; to separate one's self
from, keep aloof from (with inst.); to differ or be
different from (with abl.); to alter, change; to be
divulged: Caus. भेदयति, -यितुम्, अबीभिदत्, to
cause to break or split &c., to break, split, cleave,
divide, tear or dash to pieces; to destroy, overcome;
to separate, dissolve, disunite, unsettle (in opinion),
perplex, set at variance, cause dispersion; to seduce:
Desid. of Caus. बिभेदयिषति: Desid. बिभित्-
सति, -ते: Intens. बेभिद्यते, बेभिदीति, बेभेत्ति,
to break or split repeatedly, to divide or cut into
again and again; [cf. Lat. findo, fi-nis fr. fid-
nis (?): Goth. bit, ‘to bite;’ beita, bait, bitum:
Old Germ. biz.]

2. भिद्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of a comp.) breaking,
splitting, dividing, piercing; a breaker, &c.; break-
ing to pieces, destroying [cf. अश्म-भ्˚, गिरि-भ्˚,
गोत्र-भ्˚, तमो-भ्˚, पुर-भ्˚]; (त्), f., Ved. a
breaker, destroyer, &c.; breaking, splitting, dividing;
difference; different sort, kind.

भिदक, अस्, m. ‘cutter or wounder,’ a sword;
(अम्), n. Indra's thunderbolt.

भिदा, f. breaking, splitting, piercing, bursting in
pieces, tearing, rending [cf. दुर्-भिद]; dividing,
separation; difference; sort, kind, species; coriander.

भिदापन, अम्, n. (fr. an irregular Caus. भि-
दापय), the act of causing to break, causing to
pound or trample on.
भिदि, इस्, or भिदु, उस्, m. Indra's thunderbolt.
भिदिर, अम्, n. a thunderbolt (= भिदि above).

भिदुर, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking, splitting, piercing,
destroying; easily broken or split, fragile, brittle;
divided, variegated, mingled; (अम्), n. a thunderbolt
[cf. भिदिर].
—भिदुर-स्वन, अस्, m. ‘making a
piercing sound, N. of an Asura; (in Hari-vaṃśa’ 2289
also read मृदुर-स्वन, सृमरः खनः.)

भिदेलिम, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or split,
easily broken, brittle, fragile.

भिद्य, अस्, m. a rushing river (‘one bursting its
banks’); N. of a river; [cf. पूर्-भ्˚.]

भिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken or split
or pierced; being divided or separated; being dis-
tinguished.
भिद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the root भिद्.
